result.lens: local repair causal and proof-preservation critique

findings.summary: The proposed reference rule is coherent, but attribution of the two observed failures remains unproven.
evidence: The pending plan claims two wrong reference paths; the bound input contains neither their literal spellings nor the consumer read trace.
seed/AGENTS.md already requires resolution from the exported skill directory. The prompt amendment reinforces an existing instruction; the input does not establish why that instruction failed.
Exported skill/reference bytes, original acceptance results, and before/after consumer results are absent.
findings.action: Preserve the original failed reads and bind the containing-file references, correct existing targets, source/export/seed identities, unchanged oracle, and repaired consumer trace. Describe success as a bounded observed repair, without attributing it to missing instructions alone.

findings.summary: Standing/full selection aligns conditionally; identical execution environments and actual collection are not established.
evidence: run_quality_engine_runtime.py::_pytest_variables adds --include-release-only only for release, pytest-release, or explicit inclusion; full mode alone does not add it.
run_standing_pytest.py::build_pytest_command therefore excludes both release_only and slow_corpus in ordinary standing and non-release full runs.
Actual targets come from the quality adapter through _resolved_standing_targets; the constant printed by --print-targets is not authoritative for that resolution.
The quality gate forces CHARNESS_STANDING_PYTEST_PYTHON=python3, while direct invocation permits an ambient override. PYTEST_ADDOPTS remains inherited and can narrow collection.
findings.action: Compare expanded targets, effective interpreter, marker selection, ambient pytest options, and actual collection for the proposed commands. Explicitly retain slow_corpus exclusion alongside release_only, and verify that the final receipt represents an executed, unfiltered pytest phase.

findings.summary: Consolidation must preserve mirror preparation and demonstrated failure propagation; neither negative control has a bound result.
evidence: The direct standing runner defaults to full mode and invokes mirror preparation with read_only=false; the proposed full read-only invocation uses refusal behavior instead.
The plan correctly adds explicit export, repairing the preparation step lost when the standalone writing invocation is removed.
.agents/quality-gates.yaml declares pytest first with fail_fast=true, and run_standing_pytest.py returns the child return code.

The engine phase executor, mirror implementation, negative-control results, and final unfiltered receipt are absent. Declaration plus runner return code does not independently demonstrate that later phases stop.
findings.action: Retain the explicit export recipe and provide bounded evidence that stale mirrors refuse execution and an injected pytest failure produces a nonzero overall result with no later phase execution. Review the final documentation changes and fresh integration receipt before approval.
